title: Workspace access sparklines + rollout guardrail prototype
creator: Asha Kapoor
description: Prototype a compact workspace-level access overview combining per-role sparklines (access grant/expiry trends), a condensed audit timeline, and an in-context rollout guardrail panel. Goal: help admins reason about recent permission churn, identify risky role expansions, and surface cost implications of role-based routing changes before they go live. Deliverables: interactive Figma prototype, annotated flow for engineers, a short usability script and a list of UI tokens for implementation.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Figma prototype demonstrates sparklines per role with hover drill to recent grant events. 2) Rollout guardrail panel computes and displays estimated cost delta from role changes and suggests mitigations. 3) Audit timeline links to session-level logs and supports filtering by actor and resource. 4) Usability test with 6 internal reviewers yields no major discoverability blockers.

ux_notes: Sparklines should be 24–32px high, use muted blue for grants and amber for revocations. Hover state shows absolute counts and a link to the exact audit event. Guardrail advice is context-aware: if estimated cost delta > 15% show 'Consider quantization or caching' suggestion. Preserve keyboard-only navigation for all interactions.
qa_tips: Verify sparkline interactions at 3 resolution breakpoints. Test guardrail cost computation with mocked payloads (low/medium/high). Ensure audit timeline filters persist across route changes.
